messages:
ale: Noticed mismatch in API ref: header examples use `x-request-id` and response examples use `request_id`. Runtime uses `X-Request-Id` and `requestId`.

meredith: Good catch. Can you open a patch? We should standardize to `X-Request-Id` and `requestId` across snippets and the OpenAPI examples. Add a one-line migration note.

ale: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/521. Changes: curl/python/js/go examples, update OpenAPI response example, add migration note in /docs/migration/request-id.md.

jon: I'll update the codegen templates to preserve JSON tags and emit camelCase. Will push a codegen PR and coordinate release.

docs-bot: Preview build: https://deploy-preview-521.docs.redwood.ai 123 tests passed.

ale: Merged PR 521. Thanks!
